parts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production GAME SPRITE ATLAS derived from the attached approved rounded SD 3D wooden castle wagon. Transparent 1536x1024 PNG, EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows (24 isolated sprites, each 256x256 cell). Left to right columns are upgrade levels 0,1,2,3,4,5, with clearly progressive structural reinforcement. Match the screenshot's chunky sculpted toy-like 3D golden wood, rounded golden brackets, smooth purple tile roofs, soft warm ambient occlusion and side-on viewpoint. The atlas contains DETACHED REAL FULL COMPONENTS, never tiny badges:
ROW 1: the ENTIRE left wooden turret building with its purple gabled roof, purple flag, window, and full structural body, ending on one straight flat horizontal wooden mounting beam. No main front wall, no deck, no cannon, no wheels. Every turret has exactly the SAME bottom width and same height; upgrades change actual roofing, rafters and tower body, culminating in a richer twin-capped compact turret fitting same overall bounds.
ROW 2: the ENTIRE CLOSED FRONT WALL facade panel: broad low golden wooden fortified wall with integrated original PURPLE CROWN BANNER, thick rounded corner posts, little embrasures, full opaque wooden wall body, flat horizontal bottom edge. It is a WIDE SHORT wall, aspect ratio about 2.5:1, NOT a detached shield or banner! Upgrades strengthen the whole timber panel with metal bands, bigger golden brackets, then reinforced gold-bound wall plates. No roof, wheels, cannon or separate ground.
ROW 3: the COMPLETE OPEN-ROOM AND COMBAT-DECK WAGON CHASSIS, as one coherent WIDE horizontal module with aspect about 2.5:1. Left two-thirds: exposed single-floor room with warm wooden BACK WALL, small orange window and lantern, structural side posts, open FRONT with NO crown banner and NO front wall. Right third: clearly projecting OPEN OUTDOOR fighting platform on SAME FLOOR LEVEL, visible plank floor and diagonal underside braces, NO front railing. Continuous floor planks beneath room AND deck, substantial rounded golden-wood chassis beneath. No roof on the room, NO WHEELS at all, no cannon, no people. Upgrades change actual room walls, deck beams and chassis reinforcement. Same width, floor height and perspective for all six. This module must join the turret above left and optional opaque wall over front left.
ROW 4: ONE complete compact chunky cannon with its wooden support/mount, facing UP-RIGHT in identical side-view angle. No deck beneath, no wheels, no characters. Stage0 plain silver stubby barrel on golden wood, stages gradually add robust barrel bands and gold reinforcement, final royal reinforced cannon. Same mounting baseline, comparable size all stages.
All rows equal 256px cell height; wide short sprites centered vertically in their cells with transparent padding. Each sprite FULLY INSIDE its own cell with at least 12px margin, no sprites touch. Every row's six variants use identical scale and mounting dimensions. Keep architecture and simple readable chunky rounded shape language coherent so all independent modules assemble seamlessly into the screenshot's actual first castle. Keep upgrades modest in size, visibly structural, no extra floors, no giant wheels, no labels, text, numbers, grid lines, ground, cast ground shadows or colored backdrop. True transparent alpha outside sprites. Do not draw complete castles in the cells.

assets.name: far
assets.prompt: Repaint this exact distant background layer into charming detailed rounded SD 3D mobile strategy game art, like the approved screenshot art direction: chunky sculpted sunlit canyon rock towers with mossy rounded tops, beautiful waterfalls, distant arched ancient aqueduct bridges, soft blue atmospheric perspective, warm sun behind fluffy dimensional clouds, turquoise mist and water. Keep original composition and full canvas aspect ratio, bottom fading to flat misty blue, no foreground, no railway, no castle, no UI, NO giant boss or characters. It is a standalone opaque scrolling far background layer, not a screenshot. Rounded toy-like geometry, polished 3D render, no pixel texture. Retain comparable detail density and positions to original so pixel boss can overlay at upper right.

assets.name: mid
assets.prompt: Repaint this exact TRANSPARENT foreground/midground parallax layer into rounded lush SD 3D mobile strategy game environment. Preserve original transparent center and silhouette arrangement: tall waterfall cliffs and gnarled rounded-canopy trees at far left and far right, two small isolated rock pillars near bottom, hanging roots/vines and pink flowers. All empty areas must remain genuinely alpha transparent, especially broad upper middle, center and bottom surroundings. Rocks are chunky softly beveled sculpted stone, foliage rich clustered rounded shapes, bright turquoise waterfalls fade at their bottoms to transparency. Original full canvas aspect and feature placement, no background sky, no water plane, no boss, no castle, no UI, no characters, no ground/shadow backdrop. This is a compositing layer, not a complete landscape. Premium stylized soft 3D illustration matching rounded toy-like wooden castle.

assets.name: rail
assets.prompt: Repaint this exact transparent horizontal railway bridge layer in detailed rounded SD 3D mobile strategy art. Keep the same very WIDE aspect, exact uninterrupted horizontal railway track at y about 6 percent of canvas from top, two major support pillars underneath in same positions, alternating chunky stone/wood braces, hanging warm lanterns, moss and pink flowering vines. Keep exact rail surface height, flat horizontal top, no perspective vanishing point, no train or castle. Track extends precisely to left and right edges at matching height to tile by mirroring. Support pillars cropped at bottom edge. True transparent alpha above track and between/below pillars, no sky, background, ground or backdrop. Chunky smooth sculpted stone blocks, thick wooden sleepers, rounded iron tracks, soft golden brass details and clear dimensional lighting. Use original geometry arrangement so game wheels stay seated on track.

assets.name: wheels
assets.prompt: Produce a transparent 1536x256 GAME SPRITE ATLAS: EXACTLY SIX equally spaced 256x256 cells in ONE ROW. Each cell contains ONE complete FRONT-ON round wheel, centered x128 y128 relative to cell, outer diameter210px, identical size all6. These are the two compact wheels of the attached chunky rounded golden wooden castle wagon. Left to right upgrade0..5: plain rounded golden-wood thick rim with iron bolts and brass hub; iron-bound stronger rim; gold-bound rim; reinforced spokes; richer royal gold spokes; final royal purple-inlay golden wheel. Toy-like sculpted SD 3D materials and softly beveled rounded shapes, same lighting all wheels. Perfect complete circles, front-on with no perspective ellipse, no chassis, rail, cannon, body, text, labels, numbers or shadows outside wheel. Genuine transparent background. 16px transparent minimum margin eachcell.

assets.name: ui
assets.prompt: Production UI SKIN sprite atlas for attached game's new rounded SD 3D style. Transparent 1536x1024 PNG, EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows, SIX equal 512x512 cells. Each cell is ONE empty SQUARE rounded beveled frame/panel centered in its cell with 20px transparent outer margin. Each panel has softly beveled thick edges, attractive dimension, polished toy-like sculpted metal, subtle soft inner gradient but an almost plain readable center. Intended for nine-slice scaling into all widths/heights; keep CORNERS compact around 40px, straight horizontal/vertical edges, no ornaments on edge middle or center, no tall center crest, no irregular silhouette. Row-major: 1 deep dark teal panel with warm gold border; 2 navy/teal panel with rounded blue-steel border; 3 emerald-green action button with gold border; 4 amber/golden action panel; 5 warm red/burgundy panel with muted gold border; 6 deep purple panel with gold border. Strong bright thin bevel highlight on upper/left, darker underside gives 3D thickness. NO text, symbols, icon, numbers, pattern, title or decorations. True transparent background outside rounded panels; no shadow bleeding between cells. Match screenshot's high-quality thick 3D menus, no pixel-art corners.
